workerResult.summary: Receipt Oracle — a dark-fantasy expense fortune teller. Ink receipts (merchant/amount/category) on a tilted Offering Desk; the ledger tallies totals, stamps new rows in, and burns to ash on demand. A 500vh scroll ritual pins a sticky stage where progress drives the whole divination: chapter reveals, per-expense omens (clipped unseal + per-category accent rules), category share-meters that fill with scroll, a rotating sigil, a lid that opens on the oracle eye, the verdict, and an ashes band with share/poster/consult actions — prefers-reduced-motion respected. Easter egg: touch the eye 7x to awaken the oracle (palette inverts to witchfire, eye ignites, secret 8th omen 'The Unseen Ledger' appended, persisted in localStorage). Share/export: base64url #o= share-link that round-trips ledger+seed and offers to adopt a foreign ledger; 1080x1440 canvas PNG augury poster. Custom dark-fantasy identity (ember gold + witchfire on warm-soot panels, Grenze Gotisch + Alegreya), system grain/vignette/candle-flicker, base './' keeps dist assets relative. Verified via tsc, npm run build (exit 0), and npm run preview + curl (all assets 200).
